At least one of your parents is a half-orc descendant of the mark of finding bloodline, whether or not they manifested a mark. You have a green tinge to your skin and other indicators of orc heritage. You gain the orc trait, the half-orc trait, the dragonmarked heritage trait, and @Compendium[pf2e.ancestryfeatures.DRtaqOHXTRtGRIUT]{Low-Light Vision}. In addition, you can pick orc, half-orc, human,  dragonmarked heritage, and mark of finding feats whenever you gain an ancestry feat.

 

As a member of the Mark of Finding, you may utilise the following focus spells. Some of these spells may belong to a class or archetype. If you select one of these focus spells, they lose the class and archetype traits if they have it, and gain the Dragonmark, and Mark of Finding traits. The tradition of the spell becomes Arcane. Note that rarity is maintained, and uncommon spells should still be verified with your GM.
